lens_summary.drift: Single root cause, fully characterized before the fix. The segment header count was written as the number of persisted SegmentEntry items (records + gaps, from buffer.len()) while the replay validator counted ExecutionRecord entries only, so any gap-bearing segment failed reopen with RecordCountMismatch. Measured: declared 4, actual 3. Fixed by making the unit explicit and shared: header field renamed record_count -> entry_count, writer emits buffer.len(), replay counts every entry. No data migration (the writer always emitted the entry count). The C1.8 forced-gap UAT is un-ignored and GREEN.
